entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, this VeloBand Pulse you sent me is a piece of absolute garbage. I want a refund immediately.

I'm very sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your VeloBand Pulse. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's a technical fault! The heart rate monitor is a joke. It says my heart rate is 180 when I'm sitting on the couch. I don't have time to play games with this thing. I just want my money back.

I can certainly understand your frustration with inaccurate readings. That definitely shouldn't be happening. We can often fix that with a quick software recalibration. Would you be willing to try a few troubleshooting steps with me?
No! I'm not your IT guy. I bought a product that was supposed to work out of the box. I don't have time for this. Just process the refund.

I understand you'd prefer a direct refund. I've just pulled up your order details, and I see the VeloBand was delivered 11 days ago. For the VeloBand Pulse specifically, we have a strict 10-day window for returns for any reason. After that period, for a defect claim, we do need to verify the fault through troubleshooting before we can authorize a replacement under warranty.

Are you kidding me? Ten days?! That's insane! You sell me a defective piece of garbage and then hide behind some ridiculous policy. You people just want money and don't care about your customers. This is unacceptable.

I hear your frustration, and I apologize for the inconvenience. The policy is in place due to the device's activation linking to a user's health data. Because you are reporting a defect, our path to a solution is through technical support. If they confirm the fault, they will send you a brand new replacement unit at no cost.
I don't want another one of your broken toys! I want my money. Get me your manager, right now! I'm going to post reviews about this scam on every website I can find.

I can appreciate your position, but my manager is bound by the same policies. Without an attempt to troubleshoot and verify the defect, my hands are tied regarding a refund on day 11. The best and fastest solution I can offer is to transfer you directly to our technical support team who can resolve this for you. Would you like me to do that?
No! Unbelievable. You've been no help at all. I'm done with VeloFit. Worst company ever.
